title: Claimed lint hardening did not land: lint_demo_network.py is byte-unchanged since r2 and the 35-line cross-arm guard bleed still reproduces (r2 #11 fix didn't bite)
evidence:
window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window  // git log -- scripts/lint_demo_network.py shows only r2 commit 1c2a6a9 (zero r3 changes; test.yml diff is solely the '^import api/' grep). Reproduced on a /tmp copy: injecting an unguarded 'payment_api.create_checkout_session("v-x", "tok", ...)' in a fresh arm directly below UserToggledNotificationDropdown's demo_mode guard -> 'demo no-network lint clean', exit=0. No depth-aware arm boundary, no bite tests, no DEMO_INTERCEPTED<->demo_update.handle cross-check anywhere in the tree (grep finds only the keep-in-sync comment at line 43).
detail: The r3 bar ('the hardened lint bites: depth-aware arm boundaries, bite tests, manifest check') is claimed but absent — the script was never touched. A real api call in a fresh arm within 35 lines of any demo_mode case passes vacuously. Fix that didn't bite = new blocker.
recommended_fix: Truncate the guard window at the enclosing arm/fn boundary; add the three bite tests (unguarded arm, cross-arm guard, manifest drift) and a mechanical DEMO_INTERCEPTED vs demo_update.handle arm check.

title: store_of and download_timeout still duplicated between demo_update.gleam and client.gleam (r2 #21 still present)
detail: Two copies of the seed-fallback store accessor and the download timeout (documented as 'mirrors client.gleam's') persist; the toast helper in the same file has already drifted from add_toast (separate note).
recommended_fix: Hoist the shared helpers into one demo module (or client helpers) and call from both sites.

title: Zero-caller demo exports still shipped: result_to_seed_error and demo_store.notifications (r2 #19 residual)
detail: The rework deleted four of the six r2 orphans but left two public functions with no call sites; public fns escape the compiler's unused warnings.
recommended_fix: Delete result_to_seed_error and notifications (or wire them).

title: demo_not_in_demo_toast still diverges from add_toast's id convention — a demo toast and a handler toast can share one id (r2 #25 still present)
evidence:
demo_update.gleam:617:  let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1
                          ...
                          next_toast_id: toast_id,
// vs client.gleam add_toast:   let id = model.next_toast_id (then next_toast_id: id + 1) — after a demo toast (id=N+1, counter left at N+1) the next add_toast also uses id N+1; add_toast's 5-toast cap is also bypassed.
detail: Duplicate toast ids mean the first timeout dismisses both toasts; the helper duplicates rather than reuses the shared toast path.
recommended_fix: Route demo toasts through the shared add_toast (or dispatch AppShowToast) instead of hand-rolling id/cap logic.

title: id_suffix truncation still guarantees id collisions for same-prefix names, and its doc comment still sits on add_days_iso (r2 #27 + #18 residual)
detail: Same-prefix property names collide on vacancy id and short_code, contradicting the anti-collision comment; the stale doc placement r2 flagged persists.
recommended_fix: Append a per-store counter to the suffix; move the doc block onto id_suffix.

title: fetch_leaderboard_page still ignores its page parameter and returns the full list (r2 #28, latent)
evidence:
pub fn fetch_leaderboard_page(
  store: DemoStore,
  vacancy_id: String,
  _page: Int,
// resolves demo_store.leaderboard(store, vacancy_id) — the whole list; the response handler appends, so a rendered load-more would duplicate every row (unreachable today: page 1 returns everything).
detail: Latent duplication bug if demo pagination is ever simulated; mirror signature promises paging it doesn't do.
recommended_fix: Slice the entries by page, or have the demo handler replace instead of append.

title: Store-side change_status/mark_opened still has no status guard — audit rows append unconditionally (r2 #29, latent)
detail: Any future second dispatch path double-appends audit rows and re-fires the transition; the store's documented idempotency isn't self-enforcing.
recommended_fix: Guard change_status on slug != current status (no-op, no audit row).

title: Reminders and bulk-invite still return hardcoded counts with the store untouched, contradicting the seeded awaiting list (r2 #24 still present)
evidence:
pub fn remind_applicant(
  ...
  #(store, #(1, 0))
pub fn send_reminder(
  ...
  #(store, #(2, 1))
      sent: 2,
      invalid: 1,
// the awaiting list never reflects a sent reminder; success toasts report counts unrelated to the seeded rows (send_reminder claims a failure the 3-row awaiting list can't produce deterministically).
detail: Derived-not-serialized is the module's stated design, but these three mutations violate it — fixed canned responses drift from the source-of-truth store.
recommended_fix: Derive counts from the awaiting rows and mark reminded rows in the store so the surface re-derives.
